afterWrite.name: Lint fixes
afterWrite.details: Applies safe Oxlint fixes to changed TypeScript files.

afterWrite.name: Formatting fixes
afterWrite.details: Formats changed TypeScript files with Oxfmt after lint fixes.

afterRun.name: Mise task configuration
afterRun.details: Validates mise tasks for circular deps, missing references, and bad run entries.

afterRun.name: Installed dependencies
afterRun.details: Fails when the installed dependency tree is stale or incomplete (npm ls).

afterRun.name: Settings schema
afterRun.details: Fails when Tau settings schema drift is detected.

afterRun.name: TypeScript formatting
afterRun.details: Checks TypeScript formatting with Oxfmt without writing fixes.

afterRun.name: Lint
afterRun.details: Checks TypeScript with Oxlint without applying fixes.

afterRun.name: Unit tests
afterRun.details: Vitest unit tests with the agent reporter.

afterRun.name: Dead code
afterRun.details: Fallow unused files/exports/deps, unresolved imports, and cycles. Compact output via FALLOW_FORMAT.

afterRun.name: Duplicate code
afterRun.details: Fallow copy-paste / structural duplication. Compact output via FALLOW_FORMAT.
